description: This file defines a singleton object NoteRepository which manages in-memory notes, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, delete, and search notes.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Singleton object managing in-memory notes, providing CRUD and search functionality.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Returns all notes sorted by timestamp descending.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Finds and returns a note by its id, or null if not found.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique id, title, content, and timestamp, then adds it to the list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the title, content, and timestamp of the note with the specified id.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes the note with the specified id from the list.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of notes where the title or content contains the query string, case-insensitive.
